about: Every admin action, whether it needs a fresh sign-in (ARC-07), what it writes to the audit, and whether it works on a phone, for MP-64. step_up: yes (a story or owner record requires it), no, open (still the owner's to answer) or outside (not an MP step-up, or not an owner act: A74 is code's). The owner answered which acts need one on 5 November 2026, "Anything that writes or widens" (OWN-39): every act that changes a record, widens what MP may do or opens an original needs a fresh sign-in, and reading and stopping do not. Each row's note says which, and where the class is the maker's reading it says so. No freshness window or assurance level is approved, and no audit vocabulary (CT-03). phone: live, off, or browser (live in a phone's browser, Phone web, and off in the iPhone app). The owner, 4 November 2026: "Under Settings, phones read only", from an option that read "Changes happen on iPad or desktop; phones can read and acknowledge", and "Yes, recovery only (Recommended)", to a question about revoking a lost device and enrolling a replacement when other devices are gone. On 4 November 2026 the owner also answered: "Yes, acknowledge only (Recommended)" for a phone acknowledging an incident, "Account recovery only (Recommended)" for what recovery covers on a phone, so replay, restore and pause stay on iPad or desktop, and "The purchase (Recommended)" for what lifts MP-164's bar. The rest of the live and off split is the maker's reading, open to the owner. control: named means the act is listed, and no admin screen draws it yet. On 5 November 2026 the owner pressed "Allowed in the browser" (ADM-04) and "Finish in the phone browser" (ADM-15), so enrolling a passkey is live in a phone's browser and recovery on a phone ends there, both unverified until MP-197; "Revoke removes it too" (ADM-02); and "Any healthy path" (ADM-03) for the fresh sign-in a revoke asks for (MP-184). Nothing here approves a design or a build.
